samples.xml_description:
<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>A 64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelined stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE1">Stage 1 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE2">Stage 2 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE3">Stage 3 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE4">Stage 4 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE5">Stage 5 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE6">Stage 6 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE7">Stage 7 of the pipeline.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STAGE8">Stage 8 of the pipeline.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="i_en_reg">Register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg2">Second register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg3">Third register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg4">Fourth register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg5">Fifth register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg6">Sixth register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg7">Seventh register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        <reg id="i_en_reg8">Eighth register to store the value of i_en.</reg>
        
        <reg id="o_en_reg">Register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg2">Second register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg3">Third register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg4">Fourth register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg5">Fifth register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg6">Sixth register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg7">Seventh register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        <reg id="o_en_reg8">Eighth register to store the value of o_en.</reg>
        
        <reg id="carry_in_reg">Register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg2">Second register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg3">Third register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg4">Fourth register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg5">Fifth register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg6">Sixth register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg7">Seventh register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_in_reg8">Eighth register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
        
        <reg id="sum_reg">Register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg2">Second register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg3">Third register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg4">Fourth register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg5">Fifth register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg6">Sixth register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg7">Seventh register to store the sum value.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg8">Eighth register to store the sum value.</reg>
        
        <reg id="adda_reg">Register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg2">Second register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg3">Third register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg4">Fourth register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg5">Fifth register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg6">Sixth register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg7">Seventh register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg8">Eighth register to store the value of adda.</reg>
        
        <reg id="addb_reg">Register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg2">Second register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg3">Third register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg4">Fourth register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg5">Fifth register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg6">Sixth register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg7">Seventh register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg8">Eighth register to store the value of addb.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n) begin
                i_en_reg <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                i_en_reg8 <= 1'b0;
                
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                o_en_reg8 <= 1'b0;
                
                carry_in_reg <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg8 <= 1'b0;
                
                sum_reg <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg8 <= 1'b0;
                
                adda_reg <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg8 <= 1'b0;
                
                addb_reg <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg2 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg3 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg4 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg5 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg6 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg7 <= 1'b0;
                addb_reg8 <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                i_en_reg <= i_en;
                i_en_reg2 <= i_en_reg;
                i_en_reg3 <= i_en_reg2;
                i_en_reg4 <= i_en_reg3;
                i_en_reg5 <= i_en_reg4;
                i_en_reg6 <= i_en_reg5;
                i_en_reg7 <= i_en_reg6;
                i_en_reg8 <= i_en_reg7;
                
                o_en_reg <= i_en_reg8;
                o_en_reg2 <= o_en_reg;
                o_en_reg3 <= o_en_reg2;
                o_en_reg4 <= o_en_reg3;
                o_en_reg5 <= o_en_reg4;
                o_en_reg6 <= o_en_reg5;
                o_en_reg7 <= o_en_reg6;
                o_en_reg8 <= o_en_reg7;
                
                carry_in_reg <= i_en_reg ? 1'b0 : carry_in_reg8;
                carry_in_reg2 <= carry_in_reg;
                carry_in_reg3 <= carry_in_reg2;
                carry_in_reg4 <= carry_in_reg3;
                carry_in_reg5 <= carry_in_reg4;
                carry_in_reg6 <= carry_in_reg5;
                carry_in_reg7 <= carry_in_reg6;
                carry_in_reg8 <= carry_in_reg7;
                
                sum_reg <= i_en_reg ? adda[0] + addb[0] + carry_in_reg8 : sum_reg8;
                sum_reg2 <= sum_reg;
                sum_reg3 <= sum_reg2;
                sum_reg4 <= sum_reg3;
                sum_reg5 <= sum_reg4;
                sum_reg6 <= sum_reg5;
                sum_reg7 <= sum_reg6;
                sum_reg8 <= sum_reg7;
                
                adda_reg <= i_en_reg ? adda : adda_reg8;
                adda_reg2 <= adda_reg;
                adda_reg3 <= adda_reg2;
                adda_reg4 <= adda_reg3;
                adda_reg5 <= adda_reg4;
                adda_reg6 <= adda_reg5;
                adda_reg7 <= adda_reg6;
                adda_reg8 <= adda_reg7;
                
                addb_reg <= i_en_reg ? addb : addb_reg8;
                addb_reg2 <= addb_reg;
                addb_reg3 <= addb_reg2;
                addb_reg4 <= addb_reg3;
                addb_reg5 <= addb_reg4;
                addb_reg6 <= addb_reg5;
                addb_reg7 <= addb_reg6;
                addb_reg8 <= addb_reg7;
            end
        end
        
        <assign o_en = o_en_reg8;
        assign result = {sum_reg8, adda_reg8};
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Register declarations
        reg [63:0] adda_reg, addb_reg;
        reg [64:0] result_reg;
        reg [6:0] carry_in_reg;
        reg o_en_reg;
        
        // Sequential logic for pipeline stages
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                adda_reg <= 64'd0;
                addb_reg <= 64'd0;
                result_reg <= 65'd0;
                carry_in_reg <= 7'd0;
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                adda_reg <= adda;
                addb_reg <= addb;
                result_reg <= adda_reg + addb_reg + carry_in_reg;
                carry_in_reg <= result_reg[64];
                o_en_reg <= i_en;
            end
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign o_en = o_en_reg;
        assign result = result_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
